# Idea: a monthly swap shop in the village hall

On the first Saturday of each month the village hall would hold a swap shop. People bring clothes and toys they no longer need and take home what they like. Nothing is sold.

Two volunteers sort what comes in during the morning, and the shop opens at noon. Whatever is left at 3pm goes to the charity shop in town.

I think it will work because people keep asking where to give away old things, and the hall is free that day.
